source: The key does not fit.\n
target_zh_TW: 這把鑰匙不合。\n

source: The key unlocks the lock.\n
target_zh_TW: 鑰匙打開了鎖。\n

source: Bragit
target_zh_TW: 布拉吉特

source: lad
target_zh_TW: 小伙子

source: lass
target_zh_TW: 姑娘

source: Hail, stranger!  What be thy business?  I have not seen thee in this place before.
target_zh_TW: 你好，陌生人！你來這裡有何貴幹？我以前沒在這地方見過你。

source: I am merely exploring the Abyss.
target_zh_TW: 我只是在探索深淵。

source: I am attempting to rescue an innocent girl.
target_zh_TW: 我正試著救出一名無辜的女孩。

source: I was thrown in here as punishment for a crime I did not commit.
target_zh_TW: 我被丟進這裡，為一樁並非我所犯的罪受罰。

source: Exploring, eh?  Ha, that's a good one.  But if thou dost not wish to speak of thy crime, 'tis not my business to ask.\\m
target_zh_TW: 探索，是嗎？哈，這藉口真不錯。不過，你要是不願說自己犯了什麼罪，我也無意過問。\\m

source: Ah, a rescue mission, is it?  Should the Baron's guards not be with thee, to aid thee in thy search?  More likely one of them threw thee in here, eh?\\m
target_zh_TW: 啊，是來救人的？男爵的衛兵怎麼沒跟著你，幫忙找人呢？依我看，倒比較像是其中一人把你丟進來的吧？\\m

source: Ah, unjustly imprisoned, art thou?  'Tis the usual story, my @SS1, but that is not to say it may not be true in thy case, I suppose.\\m
target_zh_TW: 啊，你是冤枉入獄的？我的@SS1，大家都這麼說，但也不表示你的話就是假的。\\m

source: Thou needst not be ashamed of thy misfortune, @SS1; thou art in the same pot with all of us now.  If thou art to have a chance of surviving in the Abyss for long, thou must learn the lay of the land.
target_zh_TW: @SS1，別為自己的遭遇感到羞恥；如今你和我們都在同一條船上了。你若想在深淵裡多活些時日，就得先熟悉這裡的情況。

source: Indeed, I would be eager to learn of this area.
target_zh_TW: 的確，我很想多了解這一帶。

source: I will be able to manage by myself.
target_zh_TW: 我自己應付得來。

source: Perhaps thou wilt.  I have heard many say the same as thee, and a few are still alive today.
target_zh_TW: 也許吧。我聽過許多人說出和你一樣的話，其中倒也有幾個至今還活著。

source: Well, what useful information dost thou have?
target_zh_TW: 那麼，你有什麼實用的消息？

source: Farewell, then.
target_zh_TW: 那麼，告辭了。

source: First off, I would suggest picking up anything thou dost find that seems of use.  Items here are scarce enough - thou wouldst be well advised to take what thou can.\n Scavenge all you want, but stealing is ill-advised. Most of the Abyss' inhabitants guard jealously the few possessions that they have.\n Battlesites are the best for scavenging. That's why I'm here - A battle took place here not long ago - a battle between the Goblins and the above-worlders.
target_zh_TW: 首先，我勸你把找到的有用東西都撿起來。這裡的物資十分稀少，能拿多少就拿多少。\n 你儘管搜集散落的東西，但最好別偷竊。深淵裡多數居民都會嚴加看守自己僅有的那點財物。\n 戰場是搜集物資的好地方。我就是為此而來。不久前，哥布林和地面上的人在這裡打了一仗。

source: What inhabitants are there?
target_zh_TW: 這裡住著哪些人？

source: What was the cause of this battle?
target_zh_TW: 那場戰役是怎麼引起的？

source: I do not know.  It is rare that the Baron sends his men into the Abyss.  It must have been important.  Though, by the looks of it, the Goblins defeated them handily.\\m
target_zh_TW: 我不知道。男爵很少派人進入深淵，想必是有要事。不過，看樣子哥布林輕易就打敗了他們。\\m

source: The Goblins control most of these upper caves.  Two races there are, the Green and the Gray.  If they do not destroy each other, it is not for lack of trying.\n Be thou especially careful of the Gray Goblins.  I was recently imprisoned by them for trespassing.
target_zh_TW: 哥布林控制著上層洞穴的大部分地區。牠們分成兩族：綠哥布林與灰哥布林。兩族至今還沒消滅彼此，可不是因為不夠賣力。\n 你要特別小心灰哥布林。我前不久才因為闖入牠們的地盤而被關起來。

source: It must have been awful!
target_zh_TW: 那一定很可怕！

source: How didst thou escape?
target_zh_TW: 你是怎麼逃出來的？

source: My prison cell was evidently a converted storeroom, for it had a stock of useful items, including a long pole.  Using the pole, I was able to reach a button which opened the door to my cell.  I sneaked away and returned to my people.  I do not think I will venture there again.
target_zh_TW: 我的牢房顯然是儲藏室改建的，裡面還放著不少有用的東西，包括一根長竿。我用長竿碰到了開門的按鈕，偷偷溜走，回到自己人那裡。我想，我不會再去那地方冒險了。

source: And what of the other inhabitants of the Abyss?
target_zh_TW: 深淵裡還有哪些居民？

source: Tell me of thy people.
target_zh_TW: 跟我說說你的同伴吧。

source: The humans, like thee and myself, have staked out a small area in which we live in relative peace.  Below us are the Mountainmen, and after that I do not know.
target_zh_TW: 像你我這樣的人類，在一小塊地方落腳，日子還算平靜。我們下面住著山民，再往下我就不清楚了。

source: Where is this enclave of humans?
target_zh_TW: 這個人類聚落在哪裡？

source: Are all races but ours hostile?
target_zh_TW: 除了人類以外，其他種族都懷有敵意嗎？

source: A nasty place this is, thou canst be certain of that.  In the parts of the upper caves, uninhabited by Goblins, there are giant spiders and worms.  Our small group is one of the few devoted to peace.\\m
target_zh_TW: 這是個險惡的地方，這點你大可相信。上層洞穴裡沒有哥布林佔據的地方，也有巨大的蜘蛛和蠕蟲。我們這一小群人，是少數崇尚和平的居民之一。\\m

source: Thou canst find my people by going west from the entrance to the Abyss, and then north. There is a small chasm to jump over, but thou dost seem to be a dextrous @SS1.  Past the chasm is the sign of civilization everywhere throughout the Abyss: the Banner of Cabirus, marked with an ankh, the sign of the Avatar.\n Outside of areas marked with the Banner, thou shouldst watch thyself most carefully.  Most creatures who do not respect Cabirus' legacy are not particularly friendly.
target_zh_TW: 從深淵入口往西走，再往北，就能找到我的同伴。途中有一道小裂谷要跳過，不過你看起來是個身手靈活的@SS1。過了裂谷，就會看到深淵各處代表文明的標誌：卡比魯斯的旗幟，上面繪著聖者的符號——生命十字。\n 在沒有旗幟標示的地方，你可得格外小心。多數不尊重卡比魯斯遺志的生物，都不怎麼友善。

source: Perhaps I will seek this area out.
target_zh_TW: 也許我會去找找這地方。

source: I thank thee for thy help.
target_zh_TW: 謝謝你的幫助。

source: Good luck in thy travels.
target_zh_TW: 祝你旅途順利。

source: Greetings again!  I am glad to see that thou hast lived this long. It is not easy for one to survive in the Abyss without the help of others.
target_zh_TW: 又見面了！真高興你還活著。在深淵裡，沒有他人的幫助，要活下來可不容易。

source: It is easy for me.  I have no need of thy help.
target_zh_TW: 對我來說很容易。我不需要你的幫助。

source: Well then, what helpful information canst thou tell me?
target_zh_TW: 那麼，你有什麼實用的消息可以告訴我？

source: Greetings!  Hast thou visited our group?
target_zh_TW: 你好！你去過我們的聚落了嗎？

source: Nay, I have not had the time.
target_zh_TW: 還沒有，我抽不出時間。

source: I have not been able to find it.
target_zh_TW: 我一直找不到。

source: Yes, I have.
target_zh_TW: 是的，我去過了。

source: Well, 'tis thy decision.  I am sure they would welcome thee.
target_zh_TW: 好吧，這由你決定。我相信他們會歡迎你的。

source: Go west from the entrance chamber, past a door, and then north over a chasm. Remember, the Banner of Cabirus -- with the mark of the ankh on it -- is the mark of civilization in the Abyss.
target_zh_TW: 從入口的大廳往西走，穿過一道門，再往北跳過裂谷。記住，卡比魯斯的旗幟——上面繪有生命十字——就是深淵裡文明的標誌。

source: I am glad to hear it.  If thou growest weary of thy travels, thou art welcome to stay with us.
target_zh_TW: 很高興聽你這麼說。你若厭倦了四處奔波，隨時歡迎來和我們一起住。

source: I thank thee kindly.
target_zh_TW: 非常感謝。

source: I thank thee, but my destiny lies elsewhere.
target_zh_TW: 謝謝你，不過我的命運另有安排。

source: Ah, 'tis thee again.  Hast thou decided to stay with us?
target_zh_TW: 啊，又是你。決定留下來和我們一起住了嗎？

source: I think not.
target_zh_TW: 我想還是不了。

source: No, I have much to do.
target_zh_TW: 不，我還有許多事要做。

source: Perhaps I will, for a time.
target_zh_TW: 也許我會暫時住上一陣子。
